name: Cute Tags – One-Click Smart Tag Generator
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Cute Tags is a powerful tag generation plugin that helps you create relevant, SEO-friendly tags for your WordPress posts. Using intelligent algorithms based on YouTube search patterns and phrase combinations, it generates up to 30 unique tags from your post title.

Key Features

  • YouTube-Style Suggestions – Generates tags based on popular search patterns
  • Smart Phrase Combinations – Intelligently combines words from your title
  • Interactive Selection – Click to select/deselect tags before copying
  • One-Click Copy – Copy all or selected tags to clipboard instantly
  • Multi-Editor Support – Works with Classic Editor and Gutenberg
  • Secure & Fast – Follows WordPress security best practices
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized

How It Works

  1. Click “Generate Tags” in the sidebar meta box
  2. Review the generated tags (up to 30)
  3. Click individual tags to select only the ones you want (optional)
  4. Click “Copy Tags” to copy all tags to clipboard
  5. Paste tags into your WordPress tag field. Done!

Tag Generation Algorithm

Cute Tags uses two complementary methods:

YouTube-Style Patterns (Priority):
* Question patterns: “how to…”, “what is…”, “why…”
* Tutorial patterns: “…tutorial”, “…guide”, “…for beginners”
* Comparison patterns: “best…”, “…review”, “…vs”
* Tips & tricks: “…tips”, “…tricks”, “…hacks”
* Problem-solving: “…problems”, “…solutions”, “…fix”

Phrase Combinations (Secondary):
* Individual meaningful words
* 2-word combinations
* 3-word combinations

Stop Words Filtering

The plugin automatically filters out common words that don’t add value:
* Articles (the, a, an)
* Conjunctions (and, or, but)
* Prepositions (in, on, at, to, for)
* Common verbs and modals

Privacy & Security

Cute Tags:
* Does not collect any user data
* Does not make external API calls
* Processes all data locally on your server
* Follows WordPress security standards
* Uses nonce verification and capability checks
* Sanitizes all inputs and escapes all outputs
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Cute Tags”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Go to Posts → Add New or edit an existing post
  2. Look for the “Cute Tags Generator” box in the sidebar
  3. Enter your post title and click “Generate Tags”
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically add tags to my posts?

No, Cute Tags generates tags and copies them to your clipboard. You need to manually paste them into the WordPress tag field. This gives you full control over which tags to use.

Can I use this with custom post types?

Yes! Cute Tags automatically works with any post type that supports tags or is registered with the ‘post_tag’ taxonomy.

How many tags does it generate?

The plugin generates up to 30 unique tags per title. You can select specific tags to copy if you don’t want all of them.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes, Cute Tags fully supports both the Classic Editor and Gutenberg (Block Editor).

Does it make external API calls?

No, Cute Tags processes everything locally on your server. It does not make any external API calls or send data to third-party services.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, Cute Tags is fully internationalized and ready for translation. Translation files should be placed in the plugin’s ‘languages’ folder.

Can I customize the tag generation patterns?

Currently, the patterns are built into the plugin. Future versions may include customization options.

What happens if JavaScript is disabled?

The plugin requires JavaScript to be enabled in the browser to function, as it uses AJAX for tag generation.

Is it compatible with other tag plugins?

Yes, Cute Tags simply generates tags for you to copy. It works alongside any tag management plugin or system you’re using.
